Business-Friendly Description: Hoteliers can choose between 'Instant Automatic' or 'Approval-Based Request' flows. If approval-based is selected, guest cancellation requests go to the hotel manager's dashboard for manual approval instead of auto-cancelling.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Protects Hotel Revenue: Hoteliers can pause/review cancellations before refunding, minimizing last-minute losses.

Business-Friendly Description: Restructured user account lists so that they are strictly private to each hotel property. Managers can invite employees directly from their own dashboard settings.
Business / Stakeholder Value: SaaS Privacy & Security: Multi-tenant security ensures hotel user data is segregated and secure, preventing unauthorized leaks across properties.

Business-Friendly Description: Setup role-based access levels (Owner, Manager, Staff) to control permissions for different actions in the PMS dashboard.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Operational Controls: Hotel owners can control who is allowed to view financial analytics, adjust rates, or configure external connections.

Business-Friendly Description: Added a platform manager suite with Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) tracking, subscription breakdowns, system health diagnostics, and safe account impersonation banners.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Platform Auditing: Gives the SaaS platform owners complete visibility into revenue trends, customer usage, and support tools.

Business-Friendly Description: Upgraded the occupancy calendar with a color-coded availability grid, occupancy rate highlights, quick action block panels, and weekend override toggles.
Business / Stakeholder Value: PMS Staff Productivity: Front-desk operations staff can block rooms, modify rates, and view real-time occupancy updates in one click.

Business-Friendly Description: Added selector mockups for Modern Row, Classic Stacked, Minimal Bar, and Premium Capsule designs in the integration dashboard.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Direct Bookings Boost: Allows hoteliers to custom-brand their booking widget to match their external website aesthetics.

Business-Friendly Description: Configured the booking widget and guest pages to automatically apply the hotel's dynamic brand colors instead of default system themes.
Business / Stakeholder Value: White-label Experience: Ensures guest-facing pages perfectly blend with the resort's existing brand identity.

Business-Friendly Description: Fixed layout bugs where widgets were cropped or clipped on mobile. Calendars now open in viewport-safe pop-ups on any screen size.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Higher Mobile Conversions: Guests on smartphones can select dates and complete bookings smoothly without any page cutting.

Business-Friendly Description: Redesigned the checkout page into a clean step-by-step form (Dates -> Rooms -> Guest Details -> Pay) and clearly displayed hotel cancellation policies.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Improved Sales Flow: Simplifies checkout, reducing drop-offs and helping guests complete bookings quickly.

Business-Friendly Description: Added filters for guest leads captured by the AI Chatbot, booking source tracking (Widget vs OTA vs Direct Link), and a spreadsheet downloader button.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Marketing Intelligence: Lets managers analyze where bookings are coming from, capture leads from the chatbot, and export lists to run email campaigns.

Business-Friendly Description: Enforced light theme backgrounds for guests on booking screens while offering a modern dark mode layout for hotel staff working night shifts.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Optimal User Experience: Keeps customer checkout screens professional and high-contrast, while PMS users have reduced eye strain.

Business-Friendly Description: Fixed critical server bugs that caused the booking calendar and analytics charts to crash, ensuring database queries run smoothly.
Business / Stakeholder Value: Zero Downtime: Fixes critical database/SQL errors, ensuring 24/7 calendar availability and payment operations.
